newsitem.title: USA: Cusiana trades at WTI -35 cts for April loading.
newsitem.headline: Cusiana trades at WTI -35 cts for April loading.

text.p: Colombia's state-owned Ecopetrol sold a spot cargo of sweet Cusiana crude to a Gulf Coast refiner at a discount of 35 cents to benchmark West Texas Intermediate/Cushing, an Ecopetrol official confirmed on Tuesday.
The trade breaks with expectations that the Cusiana spot price had sunk to as low as $1.25 a barrel under WTI in response to North Sea and West African imports.
Enrique Lee, head of international crude trading for Ecopetrol, said the cargo loads April 5-9.
The Cusiana price had been trading around a 20 cent discount over the past several weeks until the recent onslaught of long-haul barrels, trade sources said.
U.S. domestic sweet crudes have come under similar pressure from mounting Atlantic Basin supplies.
